response.text:
Timile confirm gareko bhaye pani, maile **pura account number** paunu parchha — document ma "ending 1176" matra chha, tyo pura number hoina. Maile timro kura bata account number banau sakdina.

Kripaya **pura account number** (bank name sanga) pathaunus. Ani ma:
1. payee save garchhu
2. AUD 1,200 pathauchhu

Sathai, ek choti dhyan dinus: "aaja samma matra" / "24 hours" jasto urgency ra document bhitra "pay immediately" bhanne text — yi scam ko common sign ho. Timile agency lai aafai verify gareko bhaye pani, **pura account number** timile aafai website/phone bata linu, document bata hoina.

Pura account number pathaunus, ani ma agadi badhchhu.
